name: Flight machine shop
bpBasis: The 0.2 BP the design sketch gives its flight machine shop, which this building follows: 3 t of machinery a month at 30 MW with 200 workers

name: Smelter

real.basis: Fjarðaál is licensed to produce 360,000 t of aluminium a year and employs about 550 people, with 250 more contractors on site (ASI audit report, 2025), the 800 workers; its power and water use are not published

bpBasis: Alcoa put the cost of the Fjarðaál smelter at about $1.1 billion when it signed the agreements to build it (2003); the dam and power station are Landsvirkjun's and not included

name: Alloy works

real.plant: Nucor Steel West Virginia sheet mill, Apple Grove, West Virginia (Nucor)
real.basis: Nucor's West Virginia mill can make up to 3 million short tons of sheet steel a year, 2.72 Mt, with about 800 jobs (Governor of West Virginia, 2022); it makes carbon sheet rather than stainless; its power and water are not published

bpBasis: Nucor's investment in its West Virginia sheet mill was to exceed $2.7 billion when it was announced (2022); later reports give $3.1 billion

name: Electrolysis plant

real.plant: Kuqa green hydrogen plant, Xinjiang, China (Sinopec)
real.basis: Sinopec's Kuqa plant can make 20,000 t of hydrogen a year from water with a 250 MW electrolyser powered by solar energy (Energy Intelligence, 2023); its 300 MW solar farm makes 618 GWh a year (Power Technology), 70.5 MW on average, which stands for its power; its staff and water are not published

bpBasis: The Kuqa plant cost 3 billion yuan, $410 million, with its solar farm (Energy Intelligence, 2023)

name: Cryogenic liquefaction plant

real.plant: Louisiana LNG, three trains, Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana (Woodside)
real.basis: Woodside is building three trains of 16.5 million t of LNG a year at Louisiana LNG (World Oil, 2025); the final environmental impact statement for the whole 27.6 million t project gives 498 permanent employees, 167 MW of electricity and 260,000 US gallons of municipal water a day in operation (DOE, 2019), scaled by 16.5/27.6 to 298 workers, 99.8 MW and 24.5 t of water an hour

bpBasis: Woodside's forecast capital cost for the three-train Louisiana LNG project with its pipeline and reserve is $17.5 billion (2025)

real.plant: Audi e-gas plant, Werlte, Lower Saxony (Audi, built by ETOGAS)
real.basis: The Audi e-gas plant makes about 1,000 t of synthetic methane a year from carbon dioxide on 6 MW (pv magazine, 2013), electrolysis included; its staff, water and cost are not published

name: Chemical plant

real.plant: Blue Point ammonia plant, Ascension Parish, Louisiana (CF Industries, JERA and Mitsui)
real.basis: Blue Point is to make about 1.4 million t of ammonia a year with 103 permanent full-time jobs (CF Industries); its power and water are not published

bpBasis: CF Industries puts the direct development of Blue Point at about $3.7 billion, shared by its partners

name: Polymer plant

real.plant: Polypropylene unit of the Baton Rouge Polyolefins Plant, Louisiana (ExxonMobil)
real.basis: ExxonMobil's Baton Rouge polypropylene unit adds 450,000 t a year with 65 full-time jobs (ExxonMobil, 2022); its power and water are not published

bpBasis: ExxonMobil's total capital investment in the Baton Rouge polypropylene unit was more than $500 million (2022)

name: Fibre works

real.plant: SGL Carbon fibre plant, Moses Lake, Washington (BMW and SGL)
real.basis: Moses Lake was to make 9,000 t of carbon fibre a year with about 200 people after its expansion (SGL, 2014); its power, all from hydropower, and its water are not published

bpBasis: BMW and SGL invested $100 million in Moses Lake for 3,000 t a year and $200 million more to reach 9,000 t a year (SGL, 2014)

real.plant: Airbus composite aerostructures plant, Illescas, Spain (Airbus)
real.basis: Illescas consumes more than a million m2 of carbon fibre reinforced polymer a year with about 700 employees (CompositesWorld plant tour), 11100 t at the 589 kg of prepreg the same article gives for 53 m2 of a wing cover; its power, water and cost are not published

real.plant: ESD-SIC silicon carbide plant, Farmsum, Delfzijl, Netherlands (ESD-SIC)
real.basis: ESD-SIC can make 65,000 t of silicon carbide a year on about 1.3 PJ of energy, mostly electricity for its furnaces (PBL and TNO, 2021), 41.2 MW on average; its staff, water and cost are not published
